schema_review.rationale: The shared s1300 -> s1400 -> s1401 -> s1402 chain registers installed 1.3.0 no-vector Server storage on SQLite, seekDB and OceanBase with Code disabled or enabled. SQLite/OceanBase Code caches remain separate; embedded seekDB Code uses the three frozen released tables. A selected vector profile binds the frozen schema and domain contract to the exact historical profile ID, model, dimension, distance and normalization. SQLite maintenance registers and backfills the Atomic vec0 helper and transactional triggers; native layouts preserve vector column dimensions and explicit HNSW parameters, including ordered key columns, algorithm, distance, library and construction/search options. Unknown index options remain rejected. The vector-only configuration declaration is not a second revision or recovery journal. Full layout and domain checks precede managed use; configured or injected model drift and missing helpers cannot trigger startup repair. No embedding provider is called during migration and historical embeddings, Topic shape, authority and evidence are preserved. Full Server readiness validates Atomic Memory projections against authority and checks complete SQLite FTS identities for both vector and no-vector profiles before admission. Validation is read-only and damaged projections require explicit maintenance. SQLite startup preflight reads authority and projections in one explicit read transaction so concurrent WAL writes cannot produce a mixed-revision validation result; no schema or stored data format changes are introduced. Reviewed plans bind the draft validation resources; selected vector profiles have separately bound checksums. Target locks, original recovery points, acknowledgements and backup policies remain shared. The installed-release gate requires all twelve backend/configuration combinations, with Code enabled or disabled and vectors enabled or disabled. Vector cases seed nonempty Atomic and Topic vectors through the actual source Server, preserve exact embedding digests and retrieval shape, and verify historical/new semantic reads, configuration-drift rejection, SQLite missing-helper rejection and fresh-storage equivalence using the independently installed target. Maintenance must not call an embedding provider. SQLite vector cases also restore the automatic backup with the old Server before re-upgrading. Complete current-artifact and recovery/restore acceptance remain required. Source tests and schema captures do not establish that release acceptance passed. Policy remains upgrade-required. Revision s1402 adapts the storage already present on master: portable restore receipts and native microsecond precision for Artifact creation, policy updates, Topic publications and tag assignments. Earlier revision resources and checksums remain unchanged. Pending archive restores reject ordinary managed startup and readiness; only the explicit archive recovery entry can open a registered layout to finish projections, and it still checks the configured embedding profile. Interrupted first-revision MySQL initialization defers domain preflight until the executor has completed the registered baseline statements and seed data; missing maintenance evidence and unregistered DDL remain rejected. The s1402 portable receipt boolean is explicitly declared and registered as TINYINT(1), matching native MySQL-compatible reflection without relaxing schema matching; earlier revision resources are unchanged.
